original_query: with inv as (select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy        ,stdev,mean, case mean when 0 then null else stdev/mean end cov  from(select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy             ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean       from inventory           ,item           ,warehouse           ,date_dim       where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk         and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk         and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk         and d_year =2001         and i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports')         and i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 and 100         and inv_quantity_on_hand between 30 and 230       group by w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo  where case mean when 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1) select inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov         ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov from inv inv1,inv inv2 where inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk   and inv1.w_warehouse_sk =  inv2.w_warehouse_sk   and inv1.d_moy=1   and inv2.d_moy=1+1 order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov         ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;
rewritten_query:
with inv as (
  select w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk,
         avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) filter (where d_moy = 1) mean_1,
         stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) filter (where d_moy = 1) stdev_1,
         avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) filter (where d_moy = 2) mean_2,
         stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) filter (where d_moy = 2) stdev_2
  from inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim
  where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
    and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk
    and d_year = 2001
    and d_moy in (1, 2)
    and i_category in ('Shoes', 'Sports')
    and i_manager_id between 81 and 100
    and inv_quantity_on_hand between 30 and 230
  group by w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk
)
select w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, 1 d_moy,
       mean_1 mean,
       case mean_1 when 0 then null else stdev_1/mean_1 end cov,
       w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, 2 d_moy,
       mean_2 mean,
       case mean_2 when 0 then null else stdev_2/mean_2 end cov
from inv
where case mean_1 when 0 then 0 else stdev_1/mean_1 end > 1
  and case mean_2 when 0 then 0 else stdev_2/mean_2 end > 1
order by w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, 1, mean_1,
         case mean_1 when 0 then null else stdev_1/mean_1 end,
         2, mean_2,
         case mean_2 when 0 then null else stdev_2/mean_2 end

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Since the final query only uses d_moy = 1 and d_moy = 2, push `d_moy IN (1, 2)` into the inner aggregation WHERE clause; aggregates for other months never affect the output.
Remove `w_warehouse_name` from SELECT/GROUP BY because it is functionally dependent on `w_warehouse_sk` and never used in the final output or join.
Replace `inv2.d_moy = 1+1` with the constant `2` to help the optimizer push the predicate down and match the `d_moy IN (1,2)` filter.
Keep the CTE materialized because it is referenced twice; filtering to two months reduces aggregation input, group count, and CTE size before the self-join.
